<subject>Re: Pilbara Iron Ore Supply Agreement</subject>
<body>
Adam:

We told James Austin that we would release our Port Access Agreement and the Legal Opinion at closing on Wednesday. They were okay with that. If that's a problem, I can fax the guarantee and opinion (once I have it signed), with a letter from me saying you can't release it until funding...
</body>
<quoted>
-----Original Message-----
From: adam.costa@tasmanridge.com.au
Sent: Tuesday, Apr 30, 2024 9:59 AM
To: l157@norcorco.com; kenneth.lee@tasmanridge.com.au
Cc: vincent.james@tasmanridge.com.au; todd.vaughan@tasmanridge.com.au
Subject: Pilbara Iron Ore Supply Agreement


Good morning.

In order to finish up the Pilbara Iron Ore Supply Agreement tomorrow, please note we need the following today:

Parent company guarantee
Port Access Agreement (so that full payment can be made to Pilbara Iron Ore tomorrow)
Opinion of counsel

And once funds are received by Pilbara Iron Ore, we need the receipt of funds letter.

Matthew, I haven't heard back from the Port Hedland team to find out if the Rail Logistics contract is ready. Maybe Jake can help shake that loose.

Thanks,

Adam
</quoted>
